name: Igram Table Lamp
desc: A modern multifunctional floor-side table lamp combining a compact round table with an integrated overhead LED light. The slim dark metal frame supports a circular tabletop and a minimal disc-shaped lamp head, making it suitable for reading corners, lounges, bedrooms, and contemporary living spaces.

specifications.Fixture Type: Floor Lamp with Integrated Side Table
specifications.Light Distribution: Focused downward task lighting with soft ambient spill
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 1450 mm overall height x 480 mm table diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Reading corner / Living room / Bedroom / Lounge / Side table lighting
